subject: Runway bridge and risk-share proposal for POC
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@oregonai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Runway bridge idea for our POC

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're seeing promising signal but need an extra two weeks to finalize a key integration on our side. Rather than a straight extension, would Redwood consider a risk-share structure: a 14-day extension with a 25% usage credit up-front and a conditional 10% discount on the first month of committed capacity if we don't hit the agreed performance thresholds? This helps us mitigate internal procurement delays while giving Redwood upside if we convert.

High level asks:
- 14-day extension to the current timebox (ending Nov 15 -> Nov 29)
- 25% credit applied to usage during the bridge
- Conditional 10% conversion discount if SLA/regression targets not met at conversion

Attached is a one-page summary of the integration blockers.

Can we get a yes/no by Tuesday so procurement can plan?

Thanks,
Daniel
--
Daniel Park
Head of ML Platforms
OregonAI
[attachment: integration_blockers.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@oregonai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runway bridge idea for our POC

Daniel —

Appreciate the clear proposal. Short answer: we can structure something close, but need to align on measurable success criteria and how credits are applied (usage vs invoice). A few immediate thoughts: 

- Engineering: two-week extension is feasible from our side; we'll keep the sandbox live and maintain the same model config.
- Credits: we typically issue credits as a reduction on the next invoice; 25% sounds reasonable for the bridge period but finance wants clarity on "applied to usage during the bridge" vs a one-time credit.
- Conditional discount: fine in principle, but we need objective thresholds (latency P95, transaction success rate, and one quality eval). Laura / Monica — can you propose the specific metrics and threshold values?

Marcus — from a billing/crediting standpoint, would Redwood accept a split approach: 15% credit applied to the bridge invoice and 10% held as a conversion rebate payable only if conversion does not meet the thresholds?

I'll draft a short amendment if we align.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@oregonai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 14:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runway bridge idea for our POC

Thanks Karthik. Daniel — suggested objective thresholds for the conditional discount:

- Latency: P95 < 200ms for average request size in eval windows
- Success rate: >= 99.0% for end-to-end transactions (excl. planned downtime)
- Quality: average eval score >= 0.82 on the shared prompt set (we'll run a blinded eval at day 7 and day 14)

If any single metric misses its threshold at conversion, the 10% conversion discount kicks in. If you prefer an all-or-nothing approach we can discuss, but this is a middle ground to make the discount actionable.

Also attached a template amendment (we can fold into SOW) and a short billing flow showing split credit application.

Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
[attachment: amendment_template.docx (docx)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@oregonai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runway bridge idea for our POC

Karthik / team —

This looks good to us. We accept the 14-day extension with split credit: 15% applied to the bridge invoice and a 10% conversion rebate if any single metric misses. Please send the amendment and I'll route through procurement; we'll need a DocuSign link. Also confirm that model config and tokenization will remain identical to avoid regression noise.

Attached is a signed one-page NDA addendum (procurement required) — happy to get the amendment executed quickly.

Thanks,
Daniel

--
Daniel Park
Head of ML Platforms
OregonAI
